message:
test(apk-0232 evidence A): a test host with the logon-screen role and a tripwire; the real APK UI against it

Codex codex_apk0232_evidence_design.md (A). REMOTE60_STREAM_TEST_SEAM only, default off:
GNLINK_STREAM_TEST_PRELOGIN_ROLE=1 advertises kCaptureFlagPreloginV1 to a manually connected viewer and offers the
worker's surface (the same user-data bits stripped); the prelogin allowlist is a TRIPWIRE -- a refused type or an
effectful one (unlock, reboot, Ctrl+Alt+Del) is logged FORBIDDEN and the link closed, never answered. =2 keeps the
bits (the tripwire's own control). The real --prelogin worker, its directory authentication and capture: unchanged.
Gate: GNLINK_STREAM_TEST_PRELOGIN_ROLE listed; the test host carries it, the shipped GNLinkStream does not.
Harness: prelogin_ui (source fixed from startup, --capture-window-title; list -> PC -> desktop -> local selection ->
picture, cancel while frames are held (GNLINK_STREAM_TEST_PAUSE_PUBLISH_FILE) and pick again on the same connection,
SH off/weak/strong/화면 크기; no window list/select/thumbnail at the host), prelogin_tripwire, prelogin_ui_control
(an ordinary host: the no-window-list check must FAIL). layout_b: rotation confirmed by the screen, 크게 보기 retried.
